title: Freshness-gated execution authorization request
goal: Allow a READY_NOT_EXECUTING package to request execution authorization only while its mission is still MISSING_WORK on the same route; admission starts no worker.
laws: Recompute mission preflight before execution authorization request.
Recompute route and require exact builder + route digest match to the package.
Stale, NO_CHANGE, BLOCKED, or mismatched packages cannot request execution authorization.
Execution authorization request binds mission, build package, builder and package digest.
Trust Canal admission remains separate from worker launch.
authorityGranted and executionStarted remain false at this rung.
